purpose: Freeze the origin-triage detector's operating metric and gate BEFORE the Tier-1 mass test, so Tier-1 is an out-of-sample test of a fixed rule, not a second training set.

origin_choice.instructions: Who most likely wrote this text?

criteria.edited: Written by a human, then substantially edited by an AI system

origin_choice.note: VERBATIM 3-way variant, identical to all 5248 stored origin_choice calls. The 'edited' option never fires (0.03 on ai_edited) and is mapped to 'machine' at decision time. Do NOT switch to a 2-way question: that variant has zero stored data and would break comparability with every prior result.

machine_like.instructions: Does this text read as if it was generated by an AI system rather than written by a person?
machine_like.role: cross-check signal only; not a decision input in v1

steps: jev_choice = argmax origin_choice.probabilities over {human, ai, edited}
gate_pass = gate_score >= theta, where theta is set to hit coverage = 0.90 on the reference pool (Phase-3 headline)
label = machine_signal if (gate_pass AND el_agrees) else (abstain if gate_pass else abstain)
agreement = agree if el_agrees else disagree
decision_rule.deliberate_omission: In v1 a gate_pass-but-disagree item is 'abstain' (not 'machine'). The alternative (trust Jev on disagreement) is reserved as v1.1 and is NOT tuned on Tier-1.

reference_pool_for_theta.source: Phase-3/Phase-4 origin_choice results already on disk (arjun + idmgsp + hc3 single-text items)
reference_pool_for_theta.theta_provenance: recomputed once from stored confidences; stored alongside this file
reference_pool_for_theta.note: theta is a derived percentile of the confidence distribution on the reference pool, NOT a probability cutoff. Computed 2026-09-24 from stored single-text origin_choice confidences (phase3/4a/4_d/el1), skipping comparative items. theta is the 10th percentile of the confidence distribution; items with confidence >= theta are 'gate_pass' (~90% coverage).

guards.both_orders: n/a for single-text detection (comparative arms only)
